prompt_md: In a straight line of people, you are 4th from the left and 6th from the right. How many people are in the line?
prompt_short: 4th from the left, 6th from the right. How many in the line?
explain_intuition_md: There are 3 people to your left and 5 to your right. Add yourself once and you get 9. Adding 4 and 6 counts you twice.
